summary: NEXGEL, INC. filed an 8-K on April 30, 2026, reporting the appointment of Ian Blackman as Chief Financial Officer effective April 27, 2026, under Item 5.02. The filing details Blackman's background, employment agreement, and compensations including $275,000 annual base salary, bonus, equity awards, and severance. No departure of prior CFO or any abrupt/forced change is indicated; the filing is a routine compensatory arrangement update. As no special-situation event (e.g., activist, M&A, restructuring, or contentious departure) is present, the filing does not qualify as a special situation.
